record.paper_title: Some open problems on the classical function space L1
record.context_brief: large unconditional basic sequences in L1(mu)
record.original_question: If X is a subspace of a possibly non-separable L1(μ)-space, must X contain an unconditional basic sequence whose cardinality equals dens(X), the density character of X?

evidence.quote: Problem 10. ([100, p.38]) Does every subspace X ⊆ L1(μ) contain an unconditional basic sequence of cardinality densX ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)$ be a (possibly non-$\sigma$-finite) measure space, and let $L^1(\mu)$ denote the Banach space of equivalence classes of $\mu$-integrable real-valued functions on $\Omega$ with the usual norm. For a Banach space $Y$, define the density character $\operatorname{dens}(Y)$ to be the smallest cardinality of a norm-dense subset of $Y$. A (possibly transfinite) family $(x_\alpha)_{\alpha<\kappa}$ of nonzero vectors in $Y$ is called an unconditional basic sequence of cardinality $\kappa$ if there exists a constant $C\ge 1$ such that, for every finite set $F\subset\kappa$, every choice of scalars $(a_\alpha)_{\alpha\in F}$, and every choice of signs $(\varepsilon_\alpha)_{\alpha\in F}\in\{-1,+1\}^F$, one has
$$\Big\|\sum_{\alpha\in F}\varepsilon_\alpha a_\alpha x_\alpha\Big\|\le C\Big\|\sum_{\alpha\in F}a_\alpha x_\alpha\Big\|.$$
Question: Must every closed infinite-dimensional subspace $X\subseteq L^1(\mu)$ contain an unconditional basic sequence of cardinality equal to $\operatorname{dens}(X)$?
artifact.category_tag: Nonseparable Banach spaces / unconditional basic sequences in L1
artifact.status_search_result: Related work (Argyros–Lopez-Abad–Todorcevic, Lopez-Abad–Todorcevic) establishes only partial results: consistency with GCH that every Banach space of density $\aleph_\omega$ contains an unconditional basic sequence, and ZFC results when the density is a sufficiently large (e.g., weakly compact) cardinal. No source found that resolves the question for arbitrary subspaces of $L^1(\mu)$ with cardinality exactly equal to the density character, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Unconditional basic sequences in spaces of large density
status_evidence.snippet: shows the relative consistency with GCH of the statement that every Banach space of density ℵ_ω contains an unconditional basic sequence
status_evidence.claim: Only a partial consistency result for spaces of density ℵ_ω; full problem not resolved.

status_evidence.title: On Banach Spaces of Large Density Character and Unconditional Sequences
status_evidence.snippet: If density of X is a weakly compact cardinal, then X contains an unconditional sequence of cardinality equal to the density of X.
status_evidence.claim: Result holds under large-cardinal hypothesis on the density; general case not settled.
